llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Kia account integration for reading and controlling a user's own vehicle, with sensitive capabilities that are aligned with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Kia username and password are provided via environment variables and network access to Kia is expected; this is proportionate for the account integration but sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses npx -y kiaaccess-mcp from npm with a source link; the artifact itself contains no executable scripts, but the remote package is not pinned in the shown configuration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions require explicit confirmation for commands, default writes are limited by KIA_WRITE_MODE, unrecognized write mode fails closed, and the artifact warns not to guess vehicle identifiers or retry rejected logins.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact discloses a locally stored remember-me token that refreshes sessions silently and can be deleted with kia_forget_session; exporting the refresh token is confirm-gated and described as a full MFA bypass.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill exposes vehicle status, location, EV charging, climate, and door lock/unlock actions; those are high-impact capabilities, but they directly match the described Kia Access purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, make sure you trust the npm package and are comfortable storing Kia credentials and a persistent vehicle session locally. Keep KIA_WRITE_MODE at none or comfort unless you specifically want the agent to be able to lock or unlock the car, and treat refresh-token export as highly sensitive.
